title: identity.permission.changed.v1 payload
description: Full set of permission rows of one group in one site.

groupId.description: Group id as stored in tpermissions.GroupID.

siteId.description: Legacy site whose content nodes and modules the rows grant on.

rows.description: Every permission row of the group in siteId, in stored form; empty when none remain.

siteId.description: Legacy Masa site id, for example default, umbrella or tenant-a.

legacyId.description: Legacy 35-character id; module and root-node ids are digit strings.

contentId.description: Content node or module id as stored in tpermissions.ContentID.

siteId.description: Site id of the row; equals the payload siteId.

type.description: Grant type exactly as stored in tpermissions.Type, for example Editor, Author, Read, Deny or module.
